provider_provenance.reason: The unchanged pinned public validator already authenticates a public provider projection of its retained exact original root and complete graph. Signing that projection in the lease makes provenance explicit without a new provider input, proof issuer, private accessor or compatibility bridge.

lease_local_preconditions: exact activation policy identity and digest
behavioral_activation_prerequisites: all consumer capability/authentication gates resolved by separately reviewed pinned consumer contract
exact source/harness readiness authenticated by that consumer
source projection and scenario compilation classification resolved before any authorized preparation
repeat lease-local preconditions atomically at consumption

state_machine.tombstone_lifetime: issuing process lifetime; no cross-process restoration

authentication_domain.canonical_payload: strict exact primitive and nested types; JSON sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=false, UTF-8; domain + NUL + role + NUL + canonical bytes

authority.runtime_activation_consumed_source: authenticated current state == CONSUMED; never an immutable public counter

consumption_boundary.point: immediately before the first behavioral runtime effect, after all authenticated consumer readiness gates

public_api.common_authentication: reject wrong PID before lock; exact types and live original lease identity where supplied; retained exact original pinned authorization and mandatory unchanged public validator inside lock; signed projections, policy and state rechecked
public_api.error_type: proposed PinnedSyntheticRuntimeExecutionLeaseError(ValueError), with code and reason; not implemented
public_api.readiness_output: proposed immutable report-only readiness projection: lease_local_preconditions_satisfied, behavioral_activation_ready, current_state, reason category; not a token or permission
public_api.readiness_error_delivery: authentication, scope and provider validation failures raise typed errors; authentic ISSUED with unresolved consumer proof returns lease-local readiness and behavioral_activation_ready=false with PROOF_UNRESOLVED; authentic terminal state returns both readiness flags false with LEASE_ALREADY_CONSUMED or LEASE_INVALIDATED; defined false consumer prerequisite returns behavioral readiness false with ACTIVATION_PRECONDITION_UNSATISFIED

operations.name: issue_pinned_synthetic_runtime_execution_lease
operations.authentication: exact upstream public validation; exact scenario, provider and pinned policy; no existing one-shot key
operations.mutation: atomically install permanent key and signed ISSUED record
operations.terminal_behavior: any prior issued/terminal/collected lease rejects duplicate forever

operations.name: validate_pinned_synthetic_runtime_execution_lease
operations.authentication: common_authentication; omitted upstream uses retained original; supplied upstream must be that exact object
operations.terminal_behavior: terminal history accepted if all original upstreams still authenticate; no readiness grant

operations.name: pinned_synthetic_runtime_execution_lease_state
operations.authentication: common_authentication; omitted upstream uses retained original
operations.terminal_behavior: returns CONSUMED or INVALIDATED without restoring ISSUED

operations.name: check_pinned_synthetic_runtime_execution_lease_preconditions
operations.authentication: common_authentication; both exact supplied originals required
operations.output: readiness projection; terminal state yields false with typed reason; ISSUED local readiness never asserts unresolved behavioral readiness
operations.atomicity: one locked snapshot; not a reservation
operations.terminal_behavior: CONSUMED -> LEASE_ALREADY_CONSUMED; INVALIDATED -> LEASE_INVALIDATED in false projection

operations.name: consume_pinned_synthetic_runtime_execution_lease
operations.authentication: common_authentication plus separately established pinned consumer gates; no caller Boolean/JSON readiness accepted; unresolved consumer contract rejects PROOF_UNRESOLVED
operations.output: same original lease; authenticated state CONSUMED
operations.atomicity: entire terminal_locked_sequence; recheck preconditions at commit
operations.terminal_behavior: repeat/invalidated transitions fail; later launch/read/invoke/protocol/timeout/cleanup failure never refunds

operations.name: invalidate_pinned_synthetic_runtime_execution_lease
operations.authentication: common_authentication; omitted upstream uses retained original; no consumer readiness required
operations.output: same original lease; authenticated state INVALIDATED
operations.terminal_behavior: repeat/consumed transitions fail; permanent authorization key remains

error_taxonomy.PINNED_AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED: wrong upstream exact type, missing original registry object, rejected signature/process/binding; preserve upstream code and reason
error_taxonomy.PINNED_AUTH_SCOPE_MISMATCH: upstream public scope mismatch or exact scenario/policy scope mismatch; never relabeled authentication failure
error_taxonomy.PINNED_PROVIDER_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH: public provider/graph/proof-only or exact requirement/image/sandbox/controller/cleanup projection mismatch; preserve upstream code and reason
error_taxonomy.DUPLICATE_LEASE_ISSUANCE: authenticated permanent one-shot key already has a lease or tombstone
error_taxonomy.LEASE_UNAUTHENTICATED: wrong exact lease type, nonoriginal/copy/reconstruction, missing live identity, signature or record-integrity failure, forged or unknown record state, or wrong supplied upstream object; exact semantic scenario/policy mismatches use PINNED_AUTH_SCOPE_MISMATCH and provider projection mismatch uses PINNED_PROVIDER_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH
error_taxonomy.LEASE_WRONG_PROCESS: current PID differs from owner or authenticated lease PID; reject before inherited lock
error_taxonomy.LEASE_NOT_ISSUED: parent category for authentic terminal source states only; forged or unknown state is LEASE_UNAUTHENTICATED
error_taxonomy.LEASE_ALREADY_CONSUMED: specific LEASE_NOT_ISSUED condition: authentic current state CONSUMED
error_taxonomy.LEASE_INVALIDATED: specific LEASE_NOT_ISSUED condition: authentic current state INVALIDATED
error_taxonomy.ACTIVATION_PRECONDITION_UNSATISFIED: a defined and authenticated consumer readiness prerequisite is false; no transition
error_taxonomy.PROOF_UNRESOLVED: required consumer evidence owner/classification/API not established, unavailable or unexpected validator error; no permissive fallback or transition

unresolved_downstream_dependencies.reason: frozen reflection owners authenticate exact old owners/types; no pinned consumer readiness owner exists
unresolved_downstream_dependencies.required_action: separate audit and explicit downstream contract before behavioral readiness or consumption

unresolved_downstream_dependencies.reason: frozen executor stops before projection/compile and old compilation policy requires future classification review
unresolved_downstream_dependencies.required_action: record explicit source preparation and compilation authority/timing contract before any preparation or behavioral activation

effect_scope: contract phase only; authored contract/test/evidence files are documentation and validation artifacts, never runtime writes or capability issuance
completion_rule: SYNTH_AUTH_LIFECYCLE_PINNED_CONTRACT_1_COMPLETE only after pure validation and historical preservation; CONTRACT_UNRESOLVED if provider provenance or semantic activation boundary cannot be defined; downstream preparation/consumer dependencies remain explicit fail-closed gates
